name: Human Lion Blade (CR 8)
body:
HUMAN LION BLADE
CR 8

XP 4,800
Female human bard 3/rogue 3/lion blade 3
N Medium humanoid (human)
Init +8; Senses Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 15 (+4 armor, +4 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 42 (9 HD; 3d8+3d8+3d8+3)
Fort +3, Ref +12, Will +5; +4 vs. bardic performance, language-dependent, and sonic
Defensive Abilities evasion, trap sense +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 short sword +9/+4 (1d6+3/19–20) or mwk dagger +9/+4 (1d4+3/19–20)
Ranged mwk dagger +11/+6 (1d4+2/19–20)
Special Attacks bardic performance 17 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate [DC 14], inspire competence +2, inspire courage +2, inspiring poise +2), sneak attack +3d6, slowing strike, unexpected suggestion
Bard Spells Known (CL 3rd; concentration +6)

1st (4/day)—charm person (DC 14), hideous laughter (DC 14), see alignment, vanish
0th (at will)—dancing lights, daze (DC 13), flare (DC 13), light, ghost sound (DC 13), message

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 18, Con 10, Int 12, Wis 8, Cha 16
Base Atk +6; CMB +8; CMD 22
Feats Combat Reflexes, Deceitful, Improved Initiative, Quick Draw, Skill Focus (Perform [sing]), Throw Anything
Skills Acrobatics +5, Bluff +17, Diplomacy +7, Disable Device +3, Disguise +17, Knowledge (nobility) +14, Perception +11, Perform (sing) +18, Sense Motive +11, Stealth +14
Languages Common, Halfling
SQ bardic knowledge +1, hide in the crowd, master of disguise, move with the crowd, rogue talents (fast stealth), trapfinding +1, versatile performance (sing)
Combat Gear potion of cure serious wounds, potion of invisibility, alchemist’s fire (2), thunderstones (2); Other
Gear chain shirt, +1 short sword, amulet of natural armor +1, belt of incredible dexterity +2, mwk dagger, noble’s outfit, jewelry worth 100 gp, 38 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Hide in the Crowd (Su)

NPC can use the Stealth skill even when the only cover she has is provided by other creatures.

Inspiring Poise (Ex)

This bardic performance allows NPC to gain a +2 competence bonus on checks with a skill of her choice for as long as she maintains the performance. This bardic performance is ended by any condition that imposes a penalty to her Dexterity score or immobilizes her.

Master of Disguise (Ex)

NPC takes no penalties on Disguise checks to change her gender, age, or race.

Move with the Crowd (Ex)

NPC can move normally through groups of Small, Medium, or Large creatures that would normally count as difficult terrain. She also gains a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to avoid attacks of opportunity or move through an enemy’s square when moving faster than half speed.

Slowing Strike (Su)

Once per round upon successfully hitting a target with a sneak attack, NPC can deal 1 less die of sneak attack damage to instead reduce one of the target’s speeds by 5 feet. The movement penalties imposed by slowing strike can be removed by healing the affected target to full hit points or using a lesser restoration spell.

Unexpected Suggestion (Su)

Once per day, NPC can cast suggestion on a flat-footed target (DC 15, CL 3rd).
